ctg.plugin.title: Create Track Generator
ctg.plugin.description: A Blockbench plugin that automatically generates Create Mod track model sets: configurable left/right rails and ties, track gauge with mm/inch conversion, optional portal textures, 9 track shapes, and 4-mode export (new/classic Java, Bedrock, OBJ) with customizable model and texture resource paths.
ctg.plugin.about:
"Tools" → "Generate Create Tracks":
1. Provide three parts in a single-page config: Left Rail / Right Rail / Tie (import a .bbmodel, or "Select a Tab" to extract the elements selected in an open tab)
2. The Right Rail can be chosen directly, or "Mirror from First Model" — mirror the Left Rail along its central YZ plane
3. Enter the track gauge (px, 1/16 block; Create default 1600mm ≈ 25.6px, center distance between the left/right rails), track height, whole-model Y offset, and a new workspace name
4. Optionally import two portal textures: portal_track covers the track/ties (defaults to the part textures); portal_track_mip generates the left/right overlay blocks (teleport_left / teleport_right, wrapping each half of the ties, excluding the rails, textured with the mip; not generated by default). When both are absent, teleport matches z_ortho / x_ortho
5. Automatically generates 9 track shapes in a new workspace and applies the original part textures; the tie / segment_left / segment_right curve-rendering base groups sit under the track parent group alongside the directional shapes
6. If any part contains mesh groups (bbmodel mesh), the new workspace is a generic model, otherwise a Java block/item model; all three parts must share the same texture resolution or generation is rejected

"Tools" → "Export Track Models": exports the track group of the current workspace in 4 modes to a chosen root folder — 1.21.11+ new Java / 1.21.11- classic Java / Bedrock block / all OBJ; shapes that cannot be exported fall back to OBJ (classic: multi-axis rotation / mesh groups; Bedrock: multiple textures / mesh groups); OBJ is a single merged mesh (Forge-readable). The dialog lets you customize the model resource path and each texture resource path (namespace:path/file, defaults block/track/{id}); Java/OBJ modes write models + blockstates, Bedrock writes geometry + blocks.json, all including the texture PNGs.

"Tools" → "Track Gauge Converter": enter the gauge (mm) to get the Create curve scale constant.
  Anchors: 1435mm→0.755, 1600mm→0.965, 1000mm→0.525 (quadratic fit)
ctg.action.generate.name: Generate Create Tracks
ctg.action.generate.desc: Configure three parts (the right rail can be mirrored) and parameters in one page, then generate all Create track shapes + curve base groups
ctg.action.gauge.name: Track Gauge Converter
ctg.action.gauge.desc: Enter the track gauge (mm) to get the Create curve scale constant
ctg.action.export.name: Export Track Models
ctg.action.export.desc: Export the track group of the current workspace as Create/Kuayue-named models + blockstates + textures to a chosen folder
ctg.gauge.field_scale.desc: Read-only — computed from the track gauge.
ctg.gauge.hint: Enter inches, mm or pixels — the other two update automatically. The Create curve scale is fitted from the pixel gauge (1 block = 1 m = 1000 mm = 16 px).
ctg.gauge.generate_msg:
Gauge %0px ≈ %1mm ≈ %2in, whole-model Y offset %3px

Create curve scale = %4

Fit formula: %5
Anchors: 1435mm→%6, 1600mm→%7, 1000mm→%8
ctg.generate.done_toast: Generated %0 track shapes + tie/segment_left/segment_right base groups → new workspace "%1"%2
ctg.generate.mesh_note: (parts containing mesh groups only generate base groups; mesh elements do not participate in track shapes)
ctg.dialog.title: Create Track Generator — Configuration
ctg.dialog.part.desc.left: Import a .bbmodel from disk, or extract the elements selected in a tab
ctg.dialog.part.desc.right: Import directly, extract from a tab, or mirror from the Left Rail along its central YZ plane
ctg.dialog.need_left_msg: Select a part for the Left Rail first, then use "Mirror from First Model".
ctg.dialog.mirror_status: ✓ Mirrored from the Left Rail along its central YZ plane (derived at generation)
ctg.dialog.need_left_short: Select the Left Rail part first
ctg.dialog.portal.title: Portal Textures
ctg.dialog.portal.desc: Two optional textures: portal_track covers the whole model (defaults to the part textures); portal_track_mip generates the left/right overlay blocks (not generated by default)
ctg.dialog.portal.track_default: portal_track: not imported (track/tie use default textures)
ctg.dialog.hint: All three parts must share the same texture resolution to generate. If the Right Rail is mirrored from the Left Rail, they share one texture. If any part contains mesh groups, the new workspace is a generic model (otherwise a Java block/item model).
ctg.form.gauge.desc: Center distance between the left and right rails (1/16 block). Press Enter to update mm/inch. Create default 1600mm ≈ 25.6px.
ctg.form.gauge_mm.desc: Enter mm and press Enter to convert to px and inch (1 block = 1000mm).
ctg.form.gauge_inch.desc: Enter inch and press Enter to convert to px and mm (1 inch = 25.4mm).
ctg.form.height.desc: Height from the tie bottom / ground to the rail bottom; ties are not lifted.
ctg.form.yoffset.desc: Y offset of the whole model (ties + track), default 0.
ctg.form.name: New workspace name
ctg.form.name.desc: The result is placed in a new model workspace (also the default track id when exporting).
ctg.error.need_left: Select the Left Rail part first.
ctg.error.need_right: Select a part for the Right Rail, or use "Mirror from First Model".
ctg.error.gauge_positive: The track gauge must be positive.
ctg.error.yoffset_number: The whole-model Y offset must be a number.
ctg.error.texture_mismatch:
All three parts (left rail / right rail / tie) must share the same texture resolution to generate.

Left rail: %0
Right rail: %1
Tie: %2
ctg.import.pick_parts_title: Select track part models (left rail / right rail / tie)
ctg.import.portal_failed: Failed to import the portal texture
ctg.import.no_selection: No elements are selected in that tab; select all elements of a part first
ctg.import.pick_tab_message: Select one of the open tabs; the plugin extracts the elements selected in that tab as a part (select all elements of the part in the target tab first).
ctg.export.title: Export Track Models
ctg.export.mode.desc: Shapes that cannot be exported automatically fall back to OBJ.
ctg.export.namespace.desc: Resource pack namespace (model / blockstates path prefix), e.g. kuayue, create, mymod.
ctg.export.track_id.desc: Model folder name and blockstates file name (standard / track / meter …).
ctg.export.root.desc: The folder containing assets/{namespace}. All files are exported here, organized into models/ textures/ blockstates/.
ctg.export.model_path.desc: The resource path used to reference models from blockstates ({namespace}:path/file). Defaults to block/track/{track id}; models are written to root/models/{path}/.
ctg.export.textures_hint: One resource path per texture, used to reference textures from models ({namespace}:path/file). Defaults to block/track/{track id}; textures are written to root/textures/{path}/.
ctg.export.no_textures: No textures found in the track group.
ctg.export.empty_ns_id: The namespace and track id must not be empty.
ctg.export.invalid_chars: The namespace and track id may only contain lowercase letters, digits and underscores (Minecraft resource location requirement).
ctg.export.empty_paths: The export root, model resource path and texture resource paths must not be empty.
ctg.export.invalid_resource_path: Resource paths may only contain lowercase letters, digits and / _ . -, and must not start or end with a slash, or contain "..".
ctg.export.no_fs: Unable to write to the file system: no permission to access the selected folder.
ctg.export.not_found_msg:
The current workspace has no track group (expected to be named after the workspace "%0").
Generate a track first via "Tools → Generate Create Tracks", then export.
ctg.export.done_model_java:
Models written to: models/%0/ (%1 groups)
Blockstates: %2
ctg.export.format_note: The current workspace is a %0 model (geometry not offset to the block (8,8)); exported model coordinates are written as-is.
ctg.export.bedrock_fallback: Shape %0 references multiple textures or contains meshes; Bedrock cannot export it, so it fell back to OBJ (use the Forge/Java pipeline).
ctg.export.texture_no_data: Texture "%0" has no bitmap data; the PNG was not exported (model references keep it).
ctg.workspace.create_fail: Unable to create a new workspace (invalid model format)
ctg.export.mode.new_java.label: 1.21.11+ New Java Block/Item Model
ctg.export.mode.new_java.desc: format_version 1.21.11, element rotation supports multi-axis {x,y,z}; shapes containing mesh groups fall back to OBJ.
ctg.export.mode.classic_java.label: 1.21.11- Classic Java Block/Item Model
ctg.export.mode.classic_java.desc: Matches the assets examples (no format_version); elements only use single-axis rotation {angle,axis}; multi-axis rotation / mesh groups fall back to OBJ.
ctg.export.mode.bedrock.label: Bedrock Block Model
ctg.export.mode.bedrock.desc: One minecraft:geometry + blocks.json per shape; shapes containing mesh groups or referencing multiple textures fall back to OBJ.
ctg.export.mode.obj.label: Export Everything as OBJ
ctg.export.mode.obj.desc: All cubes / meshes are baked into a single merged mesh (one o object at the root, Forge-loader-readable).
